approvalWorkflows.name: Default Delivery Plan Approval
approvalWorkflows.description: Human-in-loop approval flow for SAP B1 delivery planning, picking, driver execution, and POD closure.

steps.title: Planner reviews suggested plan
steps.description: Planner checks sales order scope, stock availability, route suggestion, capacity warnings, and SAP document preview.

steps.title: Manager approves plan and outsourcing cost
steps.description: Manager approves route plan, vehicle assignment, outsourcing purchase request, and downstream SAP document creation.

steps.title: Warehouse confirms picking
steps.description: Warehouse supervisor confirms picked quantities before delivery document creation is allowed.

steps.title: Driver confirms pickup, delivery, and POD
steps.description: Driver accepts responsibility, confirms pickup, captures POD photo/signature/GPS, and closes delivery.
